name: Rock buckwheat
desc: Rock buckwheat (Eriogonum sphaerocephalum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 5 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Eriogonum sphaerocephalum is a species of wild buckwheat known by the common names rock buckwheat and round-headed desert buckwheat. It is native to the western United States.
